QuestInfo.0: Vaughn Tremier turned his attention to Claire. Finally, you have the opportunity to speak with Gilberto.
QuestInfo.1: Vaughn Tremier turned his attention to Claire. Finally, you have the opportunity to speak with Gilberto. You told him everything there was to know, but with no evidence, there was nothing he could do.
